caseNameFull: Walton, Administratrix v. Southern Package Corp.
attorneys: Mr. Chas. F. Engle for petitioner. Messrs. William H. Watldns and P. H. Eager, Jr. for respondent. Solicitor General Fahy and Messrs. Douglas B. Maggs and Irving J. Levy filed a brief on behalf of the Administrator of the Wage and Plour Division, U. S. Dept, of Labor, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Mississippi granted.
